messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync: we need a one-pager + webinar asset to drive enterprise leads focused on security, SLA options, and deployment modes. Goals: convert webinar signups into capacity consults. Want copy + routing rules by EOD Wed.

Diego Alvarez: Suggested hero headline options: 1) 'Secure SLAs, predictable inference' 2) 'Enterprise inference: SLA-backed and deployment-flexible'. I prefer #1 for emails. Also propose 3 social micro-copy variants (product, customer, benchmark).

Priya Nair: For the one-pager keep it skimmable: hero, bullets (deploy modes + controls), benchmark callout, CTA (capacity consult), and form fields for routing. Also add a tiny FAQ about data residency and KMS.

Ravi (eng): Benchmarks we can publish (public run 2026-01-30): p95 ≈ 120ms, p99 ≈ 240ms at ~150 tps on dedicated A100 pools for 512-token sequences. Callout: configuration-dependent. Use conservative ranges in headline.

Jules (sales): Important — inbound form must surface: deployment_mode, sla_required, industry, est_annual_commit, compliance_needs, and opt_in_capacity_consult. Route rules: SLA_required or est_annual_commit >= 250k -> Enterprise AE; else SDR. Add high_value tag for >1M.

Maya Chen: Good. Diego can you drop the 3 social variants + two headline options? Priya draft the one-pager layout (single page) and include a slide for AE handoff. Jules will map HubSpot fields. Ravi finalize benchmark line.

Diego Alvarez: Social blurbs (short):
- Product: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and enterprise SLAs. Request a capacity consult: <link>'
- Customer: 'We moved to dedicated pools and gained predictable performance and cost. Read the brief: <link>'
- Benchmark: 'Validated p95 < 140ms, p99 < 260ms under steady throughput — details in brief: <link>'

Headline pick: 'Secure SLAs, predictable inference' (email subject).

Priya Nair: One-pager skeleton done (shared drive). Sections: hero, how it works, deployment matrix (hosted/dedicated/private), security controls (KMS, VPC, audit logs), benchmark strip, CTA. AE handoff: 6-field form + 3 talking bullets.

Ravi (eng): Confirming benchmark copy: 'Public validation (2026-01-30): p95 ≈ 120ms, p99 ≈ 240ms at ~150 tps on dedicated A100 pools (512-token sequences). Performance varies by model and batch settings.'

Jules (sales): I'll build HubSpot props: deployment_mode, sla_required, industry, est_annual_commit, compliance_needs, opt_in_capacity_consult, utm_campaign. Routing rules as above. Also create automation to tag webinar registrants who check capacity consult and auto-assign AE.

event-bot: Webinar created: 'From PoC to SLA: enterprise inference patterns'  date set two weeks out, reminders at 72h/24h. Asset attached to event.

Maya Chen: Final steps: Diego polish social, Priya finalize PDF, Jules map form + rules, Ravi add benchmark line to PDF. Freeze copy by EOD Wed so legal & security can quick-review. Thanks everyone.
